with ins as (
  insert into sim_personas (rodada, combinacao, persona)
  select $1::jsonb->>'rodada', $1::jsonb->'combinacao', $1::jsonb->'persona'
  returning id
)
select $1::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('persona_id', id) as s from ins
